about: CFOP-494: one nginx crashloop on 2026-10-25, filed as rows #333-#347. The rows predate CFOP-494, so their stored payloads mostly carry no targets; each candidate and open row here carries what today's code stores instead: the accepted FIX's targets, or fold_targets derived by running agent._fold_targets over the investigation's reply. 12 of the 14 replies name apps/files/freshet-dashboard/nginx.conf verbatim. #343 and #344 annotate the id ('(via PR #50)', '(merge PR #50)'), so the target fold misses them today.
